LONG Building Technologies is hiring a Business Applications Developer to design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot internal business applications, integrations, reports, and automated workflows. The role works with IT team members and business stakeholders to translate operational needs into technical solutions and support business-critical systems, including Smartware Studio and Microsoft productivity platforms.

Responsibilities
Develop, maintain, and support internal business applications, web applications, integrations, automated workflows, and reports using modern programming languages and development frameworks
Assist in building and maintaining websites and web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related technologies
Collaborate with IT team members, stakeholders, and project resources to gather requirements, identify process improvement opportunities, and translate business needs into practical technical solutions
Write clean, maintainable, and reliable code that aligns with business requirements, technical specifications, coding standards, and team practices
Test, debug, troubleshoot, and validate applications, integrations, and web-based solutions to prevent issues and maintain reliability, usability, and performance
Participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback, and continuously build technical skills in relevant technologies, frameworks, development tools, and best practices
Create and maintain clear technical and process documentation for internally developed applications, integrations, workflows, reports, code changes, and support procedures
Support Smartware Studio by maintaining part pricing, licensing data, reports, and related business processes
Provide end-user technical support by diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving hardware, software, application, and access-related issues submitted through the help desk system
Follow IT security, access control, data protection, and change management practices when developing, modifying, or supporting business applications, integrations, and systems
Monitor and support business-critical applications and systems to help ensure reliability, availability, and optimal performance

Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
1-3 years of software development, application support, or related experience
Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, Ruby, or a similar language
Basic understanding of programming syntax, data structures, algorithms, application development concepts, troubleshooting, debugging, and technical problem solving
Basic knowledge of web development technologies, including HTML, CSS3, JavaScript, and related tools used to build and maintain websites and web applications
Familiarity with front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js, or back-end frameworks such as Node.js or Django
Familiarity with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar database platforms
Experience using Git and platforms such as GitHub or GitLab for version control and code collaboration
Ability to gather requirements, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and translate business needs into technical tasks
Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies, business systems, integrations, automation tools, and development practices
Preferred
Experience developing applications, services, or integrations using C# and the .NET framework
Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs, web services, or third-party platforms
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform technologies, including Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience with content management systems such as WordPress
Experience with SharePoint Online administration or development
Familiarity with Microsoft Graph API, Azure services, and modern authentication technologies
Experience writing SQL queries and supporting relational databases
Experience supporting production applications, integrations, ERP systems, or other business-critical platforms
Familiarity with Agile development practices
Benefits
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, Voluntary Accident and Critical Care Insurance, Basic Life, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 401(k) with employer matching contributions, Paid Time Off, Paid Community Service Day, eight paid holidays, Tuition Reimbursement, Pet Insurance, Legal, and IDShield are offered to eligible employees.
Profit Sharing/Bonus/Commission Program as applicable.
